column1: # ZAP baseline allowlist — accepted risks, reviewed 2026-09.
# Anything not listed here fails the job (fail_action: true).
# 10010 Cookie No HttpOnly Flag: the only app-set cookie is user-country
# reads client-side by design — HttpOnly would break geo detection.
# better-auth session cookies are HttpOnly already. Revisit only if a
# session-bearing cookie ever appears in this finding.

column4: Accepted: user-country must stay JS-readable; no session cookies affected.
